verses.text: A song of ascents. Of David. My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.

xrefs.text: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but associate with the lowly. Do not be conceited.
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
You asked, ‘Who is this who conceals My counsel without knowledge?’ Surely I spoke of things I did not understand, things too wonderful for me to know.

But as for you, do you seek great things for yourself? Stop seeking! For I will bring disaster on every living creature, declares the LORD, but wherever you go, I will grant your life as a spoil of war.”
Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

verses.text: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

xrefs.text: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.
Brothers, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.
Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.

verses.text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.

xrefs.text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
